# JetBrains Key Factory

Universal activator of all jb products (including marketplace plugins!)

# Features

- [x] Very simple installation (via script)
- [x] Netfilter for local license emulation
- [x] Support to all version of products

# Installation

- [x] Download [`agent`](https://github.com/L0wl/archive/refs/heads/agent.zip) branch
- [x] Copy `JBKF` folder from `agent.zip` archive somewhere to disk
- [x] Open copied `JBKF/scripts` folder
- [x] Run install script, what fits to your system

| File name       | Description                                                     | Platform  |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| `install.vbs`   | Install javaagent for all users in your machine                 | Windows   |
| `uninstall.vbs` | Uninstall javaagent for all users in your machine               | Windows   |
| `install.sh`    | Install javaagent service for user from execution environment   | Linux/Mac |
| `uninstall.sh`  | Uninstall javaagent service for user from execution environment | Linux/Mac |
